title: docs(skills): the AI skill teaches a skill's context key and its MCP record argument
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg3n6mDt5uD4hFcUB81nE9ti)_

Fixes #37611

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：照 AI 技能文档写技能的作者和 AI 助手，现在能学到「技能可以指定一个资料包」，以及外部 AI 调用这个技能时可以带一条记录的编号。
- 为什么做：属于「记录 AI 问询」专题的收尾，这项能力已经上线，对外发布的技能文档里还没有。
- 出错会怎样：只改文档文字和一条评测用例，不动产品。写错的话助手会学到错误说法，撤回这次合并即可。
- 要你做什么：这是受管的技能文件，需要审批人批准后才能合并。

## What changes

Three files of the published `objectstack-ai` skill, plus a `patch` changeset for `@objectstack/skills`.

1. `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md`, Skill Configuration: the optional-keys table gains a `context` row. It is the bare name of the context pack the skill works from, resolved in the skill's package and then its dependency closure, and the parse refuses the skill unless `tools` binds `get_record_context`, by name or wildcard. The Context packs pointer names "a skill's `context` over MCP" among what the reference holds.
2. `skills/objectstack-ai/references/context-packs.md`, Serving and calling it: one paragraph on a skill's `context`. Where the name resolves to a pack and the server serves `get_record_context`, the skill's MCP prompt takes an optional `recordId`. With it the message is the instructions, a fixed line asking for that call and its arguments as JSON, and the record is never inlined. Without it the prompt is unchanged. The `os validate` table gains two rows: `ai-skill-context-unknown` (a `context` no pack of the stack's own has; a dependency's pack is not read) and `ai-skill-context-omitted` (a skill binding the tool without `context`, while an object has several packs). The table's second header becomes "Reported for", since two rows are now about a skill.
3. `skills/objectstack-ai/evals/skills-tools-knowledge.json`: case 12 asks for a skill over a shipped context pack that an external agent can start from a record over MCP. The file joined the surface by claim amendment 7201200927, and the maintainer chose to carry the case in this pull request (decision card in the project thread, 2026-11-26T19:22Z).

Both prose files sat at or within 3 tokens of their ratchet row, so the new words are paid for in the same file. No ceiling moves and no ratchet row is edited.

### What `SKILL.md` gives up

| Cut or rewording | Why it is restatement |
|:--|:--|
| `instructions` row: "for this skill's context" | a gloss on "Prompt guidance"; it also collides with the new key's name |
| `instructions` row: "**The one field the open edition serves**:" becomes "On the open edition" | no longer true: `tools`, `mcpPrompt` and now `context` are read there too. Which keys are inert on the open edition is said under Platform agents |
| `instructions` row: "is not listed as a prompt at all" becomes "is not listed" | the same clause already says the field is projected onto the MCP `prompts` primitive |
| Skill example comment, two lines become one | "Every name resolves" is the `tools` row's "every name must resolve"; "materialised from this stack's own Action" is rung 3 of the ladder above it |
| "whatever the binding;" | restates "on any connection" in the same sentence |
| "Bind a tool no MCP family serves (the MCP table above) and no filtering server offers the skill." | the same rule from the author's side: four lines up, a skill is offered "only when its server lists every tool the skill binds" |

### What `context-packs.md` gives up

| Cut or rewording | Why it is restatement |
|:--|:--|
| Opening: "fields of the root object, child lists that point at the record, and one long-text field read as its body" | the Keys table's `fields`, `related` and `body` rows |
| Opening: "A pack is no permission: it grants nothing and hides nothing" becomes ": a pack grants nothing and hides nothing" | the label only; both facts stay |
| Opening: "Several packs may root on one object." | the first bullet under Serving and calling it ("several are refused `400`") |
| ", so nothing is cut silently at call time" | the consequence of "refused at parse" in the same sentence. Flagged to the area: a consequence clause, not a word-for-word repeat |
| `name` row: "; what the tool's `context` argument names" | the bullets "A pack is identified by its package and its name" and "`context` takes a pack's face" |
| `label` row: ", and how the pack is listed when its object has several" | the first bullet: "each listed by its face and `label`" |
| `object` row: "A call reads one record of it" | the opening line: "one record" |
| `fields` row: "root" | the table is the root's; `object` is "The root object" |
| `where` row: "Which rows:" | a lead-in to "A filter on the child's own fields". Flagged to the area with the clause above |
| `limit` row: "20 is the default and the cap. A cut list says so in the answer" becomes "default 20" | "the cap" is "1 to 20"; "`notes` say what was withheld or cut" is under Serving and calling it |
| "each with an `anchor`, and the model reads one section by calling again with that `anchor`" becomes "the model reads one section by calling again with a heading's `anchor`" | same fact, fewer words |
| "With neither, no such tool is served, whatever packs the stack holds." | the paragraph opens: the tool "exists only on a host that mounts" the service |
| "without it the read is refused `409`" becomes "or is refused `409`" | same fact |
| "Read as the caller:" | the opening line: "reads every part as the caller" |
| "An author's mistake is silent at the tool. `os validate` reports it as a warning:" becomes one sentence | same two facts |

Kept on the area's word: the two pieces of authoring advice ("Give a list its `where`, `orderBy` and `limit`…" and "…so give a long body headings") and ", as a skill is". An earlier draft cut them.

## Why

`main` has the key and the argument since the parent card's pull request landed (ADR-0160 D8; resolution by ADR-0150 D3). The published skill named neither, so an assistant that learns skill authoring from it could not tell an author that a skill can name its pack, that the binding is required, or what an MCP client gets for a record id.

Read against `main` at `6592546c`:

- `packages/spec/src/ai/skill.zod.ts`: `context` is an optional bare name (a face is refused by the name pattern); `refuseUnboundRecordContext` refuses a skill that declares it without `get_record_context` bound, by name or a matching wildcard (`skillBindsRecordContextTool`).
- `packages/mcp/src/skill-prompts.ts`: `skillPromptRecordContext` resolves the name from the skill's package, then its closure; a prompt whose pack resolves lists `recordId` (optional); `skillPromptResult` builds the message as the instructions, a blank line, the fixed line, and the call as one JSON object. The stdio server offers the argument only where it registers `get_record_context`; the HTTP door serves the skill only where the server serves every tool it binds.
- `packages/lint/src/validate-ai-tool-references.ts`: the two rule ids, both warnings; the unknown-pack rule reads the stack's own `aiContexts` only.

## Tests

Documentation and an eval fixture only: no package source changes, so no package test suite is owed. No ablation: the diff changes no tested behaviour.

The bundle grows by 336 tokens: 1 in `SKILL.md` and 335 in the eval fixture, which the ratchet measures and does not price.

The eval case's reference answer carries each of its five `must_contain` tokens and neither `must_not_contain` token (checked by script against the grader's literal match).

## Acceptance notes

- Acceptance 1 (both files teach the key and the MCP argument as `main` has them; the ratchet exits 0; skills gates and `check:generated` green): see Why for the readings; `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` exits 0 with both rows inside their ceiling; `check:skill-docs`, `check:skill-refs`, `check:skill-examples` (352 prose examples) and spec `check:generated` (14 artifacts up to date) are green. No generated mirror moved.
- Acceptance 2: `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` are below and in the changeset.
- Not taught, on purpose, to stay inside the rows: a blank `recordId` is refused (`-32602`); an environment skill resolves its `context` as a caller with no package; a host that hands the prompt surface no package closure resolves a package skill's `context` in its own package only; the omitted-context warning is one finding per object. None is something an author writes differently for.
- The eval follow-up card the area filed while the decision card was open, #37669, was withdrawn as not planned; this pull request carries the case.
- A changeset is included because `skills/**` ships as `@objectstack/skills` and the changeset check requires one; the level is `patch` (`Metadata-protocol: none`).
- Noted, not changed: `SKILL.md` cites `packages/spec/src/ai/skill.zod.ts:37-51, 139-202` under Trigger Conditions. The merged change added an import to that file, so those ranges now sit one line low. A line citation in published prose drifts with every edit to the file it names.
- Deviation from the dispatch order: the commits' `Claude-Session` trailer names this card thread's own session, as the harness stamps it, where the order printed the area's session. The trailer pair is model-free and `check:commit-card-trailers` accepts it.

## Verification

Two-minute check: `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` prints `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md is 6799 tokens (ceiling 6801; headroom 2)` and `context-packs.md is 1454 tokens (ceiling 1454; headroom 0)`, and exits 0.

Read first, by risk: (1) the `context` row in `SKILL.md` against `refuseUnboundRecordContext`; (2) the "A skill's `context`" paragraph and the two new table rows in `context-packs.md` against `skill-prompts.ts` and the lint rule; (3) the two cut tables above, for any line you would rather keep.
